methodology.switching: Cycle through nine strategies after consecutive non-wins; reset streak after switching
methodology.limitations: Synthetic equal-strength clubs, fresh lineups per match; no season injuries, suspensions, fatigue, transfers or MongoDB. Only one club adapts per paired season. Intervals use independent seed blocks and are exploratory, without multiple-comparison correction.
methodology.dominance_rule: At least ten independent seeds; leader exceeds every alternative by >0.06 points/game at the lower approximate 95% paired interval bound
